faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT cam and groove coupling?
faqs.a: The 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT (1-1/2", 2" and 3") is a low-to-medium pressure transfer fitting, not for high-pressure hydraulic service. The maker's figures fall with size, 150 psi at 3 inch and 4 inch and 75 psi at 5 inch and 6 inch, so read the datasheet for the size you order.

faqs.q: What materials does the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT cam and groove coupling come in?
faqs.a: The 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT is listed in aluminium, Polypropylene, Plated Iron (selected types). Choose the body for the medium: aluminium for general service, stainless steel for corrosive duty, and ask for the gasket that suits the fluid.

faqs.q: Which gasket does the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT use and what are the options?
faqs.a: The 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT in 1-1/2" to 3" has a Buna-N (nitrile) standard gasket, suited to petroleum, water and most general-service fluids. Viton (FKM), EPDM, PTFE and Neoprene are available on request: Viton for fuels and aggressive solvents, EPDM for ketones and water, PTFE for the most demanding chemical duty.

faqs.q: Which standards does the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT cam and groove coupling meet?
faqs.a: The listing gives A-A-59326 (the US specification, formerly MIL-C-27487) and EN 14420-7 (Europe) for the 90° elbow Type F range. The cam-and-groove profile is the same for a given Type and size, so a half of the same Type from another maker mates when it follows the same standard.

faqs.q: What does the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT cam and groove coupling connect to?
faqs.a: The cam end of the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT connects to a female coupler such as a Type B, C or D, of the same size. See [cam and groove coupling types](/blog/cam-and-groove-coupling-types) for how Types A to F, DC and DP pair up.

faqs.q: 90° elbow or straight Type F cam and groove coupling: which one?
faqs.a: The 90° elbow Type F (male adapter end) turns the line at the coupling to clear obstructions, while the [straight standard Type F](/p/standard-type-f-male-adapter-male-npt-cam-and-groove-coupling) keeps the line in a straight run. Use the elbow in tight spaces, and the straight type everywhere else.

faqs.q: How is the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT cam and groove coupling installed?
faqs.a: On the 90° elbow Type F male adapter x male NPT, seal the NPT thread with a suitable sealant and tighten it into the port, then engage the cam arms on the mating half. Check the gasket is seated before you pressurise.
